import re

# Reuse simple_note variables from earlier execution if present

note_content = note_resp.get('content')
items=[]
for line in note_content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    m=re.match(r'[-\*]?\s*(\d+)\s*[xX]\s*(.*)', line)
    if m:
        qty=int(m.group(1))
        name=m.group(2).strip()
        items.append({'name':name,'quantity':qty})

print('parsed_items:', items)

    s=s.lower()

    parts=[p for p in s.split() if p and p not in {'x','qty','quantity','liters','liter','personal','true'}]
    return parts

def best_match(query_name, results):
    q_tokens=set(tokenize(query_name))
    if not q_tokens:
        return results[0]
    best=None
    best_score=-1
    for r in results:
        r_name=r.get('name','') or ''
        r_tokens=set(tokenize(r_name))
        inter=len(q_tokens & r_tokens)
        union=len(q_tokens | r_tokens) if (q_tokens | r_tokens) else 1
        score=inter/union  # Jaccard
        # tie-breaker: longer name match
        if score>best_score:
            best_score=score
            best=r
    return best
